data.name: Demons Killers
data.detailed_description:
Liztheuz is closed. No teachers. No students. Just you… and two hunters.

You play as Lidia (19), waking up inside an empty university that no longer feels normal. You’re not here to fight. You’re here to escape.

Rachel is cold, precise, and angry—she will hunt you nonstop. Lorna is pure chaos, and she wants you dead. There’s no “fair” negotiation. Your only way out is to run, hide, use items, and learn routes until you reach the final exit.

What to expect

  • First-person chase & escape (no fair combat).

  • Two hunters with distinct pressure styles.

  • Routes, shortcuts, and movement (including slide/parkour) to survive.

  • One life: if you die, you restart the escape from the beginning.

  • Basic violence (blade, hits, gunfire). All characters are 19+.

HOW TO ESCAPE

  • Collect key fragments.

  • Use glue in the correct spot to unlock the next step.

  • Enter the teachers’ room and get what you need.

  • Solve the code blocking your progress.

  • Open the safe when you have access.

  • Reach the dojo and get the last key item.

  • Get the final key and find the exit.

Hesitate, you lose time. Lose time, they find you.

content_descriptors.notes:
Mature Content Description:
This is a horror game featuring hostile pursuit and violence. It includes depictions of injury/death, blood effects, and violence involving bladed weapons and firearms. The game also contains themes of abduction, intimidation, and psychological horror. There is no explicit sexual content or nudity. No depiction of sexual assault, BDSM, self-harm, or drug/alcohol abuse beyond any implied sedation.
